coverage.evidence: m3_look.mjs + explore.mjs in Chromium 131: tile/expanded/no_plan/setup at 375/768/1280 (+1920/2560 dialog), light+dark; rendered font sizes, font families, legend dot vs series paint, empty state. Spacing tokens, headline alignment, error states and sv not measured.

unfinished.what: Spacing consistency against the --hpo-space scale across states, headline-number alignment across tiles/stats, error states (pin_fail, save_fail, status_fallback), and the sv language were not measured.

findings.title: No-plan empty state shows all 8 legend chips (focusable) above the diagnosis on the inline card
findings.claim: With no plan entities (hass.states={}), the inline card renders 8 visible, focusable legend chips for series that do not exist, while the expanded dialog in the same state renders 0.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, load1 21-29; count is contention-immune

findings.metric_definition: Count of `.legend .chip` elements with a client rect in the card shadow root when hass.states is empty; control: same count inside the open dialog (0).
findings.phenomenon_property: A chart-only control (legend chip) is rendered when no chart is rendered; the inline and dialog paths gate the legend differently on anyData.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n 'this.legend.html(' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js  (every call site must gate on anyData)
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Gate the inline legend on anyData as the dialog already does (one line in _render).

findings.title: Expanded dialog chart and setup-diagram text render larger than the dialog title
findings.claim: In the expanded dialog the largest chart SVG text renders at 1.104x the dialog title at 1280 px and 1.112x at 1920/2560, and the setup diagram text at 1.190/1.198x, inverting the heading hierarchy.

evidence.unit: ratio (max svg text px / dialog title px, plan page, 1920)
evidence.contention_note: shared box, load1 21-29; geometry ratio is contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb=font: `const font = Math.min(chartFontUnits(drawnWidth, expanded ? FONT_EXPANDED : FONT_BASE), drawnWidth ? 13 * VIEW_W / drawnWidth : Infinity);`
perturbation.expected_direction: plan ratio down below 1 (measured 0.884 at 1280, 0.889 at 1920/2560); setup seam unchanged at 1.19

findings.metric_definition: max over visible <text> in the dialog's chart (or setup) svg of computed fontSize x getScreenCTM().a, divided by the dialog .title computed font-size.
findings.phenomenon_property: Dialog SVG text is sized in viewBox units with no px ceiling relative to the HTML chrome, so it scales past the dialog's heading.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n 'viewBox="0 0 ${' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js  (each dialog svg whose text is in viewBox units)
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Cap rendered dialog svg text (chart and setup diagram) below the dialog title size, in the same place the floor is computed.

non_findings.claim: Legend dot colour equals the series' painted stroke/fill for every drawn series, light and dark; the dashed solar series gets a dashed swatch
non_findings.value: 7/7 equal per theme (e.g. price rgb(74,58,167) light, rgb(144,133,233) dark)

non_findings.claim: All card text uses one inherited font family; only the diagnostic entity ids use monospace (<code>)
non_findings.value: families {Arial, monospace(4 code runs in no_plan)}

non_findings.claim: Tile chart text keeps the 8 px rendered floor on a phone
non_findings.value: 8.0 px min rendered svg text at 375
